results.title: Build your presentation offline
results.body: A presentation editor for developers that keeps text editable and saves local copies.
items: Keep slide text editable as your ideas change.
Save local copies for review and reuse.
results.notes: Develop your presentation offline, revise the text directly, and save local copies as your work evolves.

results.title: 本地优先，分三步完成演示
results.body: 在本地整理内容、检查版式并导出副本，让修改和交付清晰可控。
items: 整理大纲：用 JSON 组织标题与要点。
检查排版：在本地 HTML 中预览并调整。
导出副本：保存可编辑的 PowerPoint。
results.notes: 先用 JSON 整理大纲，再通过本地 HTML 检查排版，最后导出 PowerPoint 副本。整个流程围绕本地文件展开，便于继续修改和保留版本。

results.title: A local star, an editable caption
results.body: Pair an original local abstract star illustration with the caption: “Ideas take shape.”
items: Place the local star illustration beside the caption.
Keep the caption and supporting text editable.
results.notes: Use an existing original local illustration; this plan requires no image generation or network access. The star is decoration, not scientific evidence. If the image is unavailable, display its text description alongside the caption.
results.alt: Abstract star illustration with angular points radiating from a central shape.
results.fallback: Display editable text: “Abstract star illustration — Ideas take shape.”

results.title: Choose your presentation route
results.body: Explore locally in HTML or use a static, editable PowerPoint. Keep every word editable in either route.
items: Local HTML: explore content through tabs.
PowerPoint: review static slides and edit their text.
results.notes: Select a tab to compare the two routes. Local HTML supports exploration; PowerPoint presents static, editable slides. Keep labels, descriptions, and all other words as editable text. For a static fallback, display both choices side by side.
results.fallback: Show both choices side by side with editable headings and text.

results.title: Clamp the next index to valid bounds
results.body: Handle an empty range, advance the index, and clamp the result to 0..count-1.
items: Return 0 when count is zero or negative.
Advance the supplied index by one.
Clamp between 0 and the last valid index.
results.notes: The original function allowed count, which lies beyond the last valid index. Return 0 for count<=0, then clamp index+1 between 0 and count-1. For a positive integer count, -1 becomes 0, 0 advances when possible, and the last index stays unchanged.
